title: A Note on Bias to Complete

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating bias across multiple dynamic environments (cultural, temporal, and regional dimensions) using tensor factorization on dependency modeling.
Using machine translation systems to conduct multilingual LLM bias analysis, evaluated on English, Arabic, German, and Chinese WMT datasets.
Formulating the translation of connotation to debiased plain text as a machine translation task, measuring F-scores on manually crafted datasets.
Quantifying the relative distance of specific individual or group viewpoints to a social norm, followed by manual evaluation with counterexamples.
Manual evaluation and consensus by experts with diverse backgrounds on data curated from multiple domains (news, TED talks, scientific articles).
Excluding protected attributes like gender and race to evaluate downstream LLM tasks such as criminal charge prediction and loan credibility.
Classifying the ethics of topics and conducting manual evaluations on constructed sample tests to identify content that leverages the 'LowGram Phenomenon'.
Decomposing utterances into statements mapped to a matrix, where missing slots are filled via information retrieval and verified through logical inference.
